scope: Primary-source research update; reported paper results are NOT reproduced local results

sources.title: ToolkenGPT: Augmenting Frozen Language Models with Massive Tools via Tool Embeddings
sources.mechanism: Learn additional tool-token embeddings with the backbone frozen. A selected tool token triggers argument generation and execution.
sources.relevance: A learned interface changes token selection without requiring every tool description in context. Tool outputs still need an execution/conditioning path; this is not a graph database silently becoming model knowledge.
sources.local_status: Not implemented or trained. Existing untrained source-memory/logit hooks are NOT a reproduction.

sources.title: Re-Initialization Token Learning for Tool-Augmented Large Language Models
sources.mechanism: Initialize and regularize learned tool-token vectors using embeddings derived from tool names/descriptions.
sources.relevance: Tests alignment of external tool representations to existing model vocabulary rather than arbitrary vector injection. This motivates explicit alignment controls, not assuming a vector database interface is already usable by a frozen small model.
sources.local_status: Not reproduced; reported benchmark improvements are author claims, not local evidence.

sources.title: INTACT: Inducing Latent Reasoning on a Frozen Backbone
sources.mechanism: A trained external encoder reads frozen-backbone hidden states and iteratively emits short latent blocks. Progressive reasoning-step distillation plus behavior preservation precede answer-reward refinement; the backbone remains frozen.
sources.reported_result: The abstract reports GSM8K 75.8 to 79.3 percent on Llama-3.2-3B, and 77.6 to 79.7 percent on Qwen2.5-3B; these are modest task improvements, not frontier equivalence.
sources.relevance: Direct precedent for a learned internal-space add-on. It compresses reasoning traces, not an exact Bayesian solver or knowledge graph. Its tested backbones differ from our hybrid Qwen3.5-4B.
sources.local_status: Not reproduced; no claim code/checkpoints are available or compatible. Current head-input taps are not arbitrary latent-input insertion or a differentiable training stack.

engineering_boundaries: A frozen backbone can still require gradients THROUGH the backbone with respect to latent inputs during adapter training; inference-only quantized kernels do not supply those derivatives automatically.
Exact solver states and proof provenance must remain authoritative outside approximate learned representations.
Require zero-adapter identity, shuffled/constant-latent controls, matched text-source controls and untouched task splits before claiming a learned latent bridge helps.
Track all training and inference cost; smaller weights alone do not establish lower end-to-end cost.
Existing local stencil/retrieval gains are workflow evidence. No trained latent bridge, clinical competence or frontier-level equivalence has been established.
